items.html: And there is also for him the aspect of the Keter of ZA, for it is not included in the Mochin of Gadlut, for these Mochin are only the KHB of ZA. And further on, after the explanation of the Mochin, we shall explain the matter of the Keter. And understand these three aspects very, very well. And know that all these aspects are the Tzadi of the Tzelem, called Daat, as mentioned in the aforementioned discourse.
